text:
alex: Nightly CI red on macOS-arm64 (build #342). TestRetryOrdering::handles_overlap failing 3/5 runs. CI link: https://ci.redwood/invocations/342 (logs attached).

alex: relevant snippet:
```
thread 'TestRetryOrdering::handles_overlap' panicked at 'assertion failed: response timed out', src/runtime/retry.rs:214
stack: runtime::serve::retry::handle -> runtime::timer::sleep -> sys::nanosleep
duration: expected <120ms, got 240ms
```

maria: ugh. Is this only on mac-arm? any repro locally?

alex: I tried on my linux amd64 laptop, repeated 200x, zero failures. Fails only on mac-arm CI. Looks timing-related.

jamal: I think this smells like seed/timer granularity. Could be nanosleep accuracy on arm CI. @devops-bot can you queue a rerun with a fixed RNG seed and increased logging?

devops-bot: Rerun queued: job 98765 (matrix: arch=macos-arm64, seed=42, log=debug). I'll post updates.

ryan: Also can we try a stress loop? ./scripts/stress_test --test retry::handles_overlap --arch macos-arm64 --iterations 1000

alex: noted. I can't repro locally either; CI noise only.

maria: before we change the test, can we git-bisect the range? when did this start appearing? I saw one failure ~2 days ago.

jamal: I can run a bisect tomorrow morning across the last 50 commits touching runtime/serve. @ci-bot can you run an automated bisect job? If not, I'll do local bisection using the CI images.

ci-bot: Automated bisect is not enabled for macos-arm64. Creating a manual bisect task assigned to jamal. Progress updates will be posted here.

ryan: Given this blocks nightly stability, quick mitigation: add flaky-skip on macos-arm64 nightly and open an issue to revert. Maria, can you handle the PR?

maria: I can. I'll add a skip-on-macos-arm attribute with a TODO and link to this thread/issue.

alex: Action items:
- jamal: run bisect and post first bad commit (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- maria: PR to mark test flaky on macos-arm64 nightly (ETA: today EOD)
- ryan: schedule stress job on mac-arm CI and keep it running for 24h

jamal: ack. I'll start bisecting and try reproducing on the suspected commits. If I find a determinism/seed clue I'll post a minimal repro.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5496 (skips test on mac-arm nightly, includes issue link)

devops-bot: job 98765 completed: 1 failure / 3 runs — logs uploaded to https://ci.redwood/logs/98765

alex: thanks all. keeping this thread for updates. tagging @eng-oncall in case it spikes.

ryan: adding label `ci:flaky` and `investigate:timing` to the issue. :mag: :arm:

jamal: first bisect run narrowed to commits 1603..1608, suspecting a timer refactor in 1605. Will dig in.

alex: small note — avoid changing production code just to appease test. prefer test guard + proper repro and fix.

maria: agreed. will revert skip once we have a fix and repro. Thanks!
